name: Katase Yuzu
source: A girl who lives in a different apartment in the same building as the protagonist. She has a fatherless family, so she's always by herself. She is shy toward strangers, so she doesn't speak very much. However, it seems she's hoping for something from the protagonist, so she watches his comings and goings.
